# Public source follow-up v2

These six files were not used for the v1 parser/resolver development. References
and target ownership were manually annotated before either v2 provider was run.
The original pilot is now regression data. Full provenance/hashes and upstream
MIT licenses are retained; source is unmodified and must not be executed.

Rust re-export gold identifies the defining source.rs and node.rs; abstention
must remain FN. The TS registry alias has no annotated target/config in this
partial snapshot and is tracked as unknown. This small convenience sample is
not representative and does not establish automatic scope-removal safety.
